# QuerySafetySettings

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Auth.Profiles.QuerySafetySettings`

## Summary

#### CrossEnvironmentDmlPolicy


Cross-environment DML policy. Default: ReadOnly.


#### DateTimeMode

```text
PPDS.Auth.Profiles.DateTimeMode DateTimeMode { get; set; }
```

DateTime display mode. Default: UTC.

```text
System.Boolean BypassPowerAutomateFlows { get; set; }
```

Suppress Power Automate flow triggers on DML. Default: false.


#### PreventDeleteWithoutWhere

```text
System.Boolean PreventDeleteWithoutWhere { get; set; }
```

Block DELETE without WHERE clause. Default: true.


#### PreventUpdateWithoutWhere

```text
System.Boolean PreventUpdateWithoutWhere { get; set; }
```

Block UPDATE without WHERE clause. Default: true.


#### ShowFetchXmlInExplain

```text
System.Boolean ShowFetchXmlInExplain { get; set; }
```

Include FetchXML in EXPLAIN output. Default: true.


#### UseBulkDelete

```text
System.Boolean UseBulkDelete { get; set; }
```

Route full-table DELETE to async BulkDeleteRequest. Default: false.


#### UseTdsEndpoint

```text
System.Boolean UseTdsEndpoint { get; set; }
```

Route SELECT queries to TDS read replica. Default: false.


#### DmlBatchSize

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> DmlBatchSize { get; set; }
```

Records per DML batch (1-1000). Default: 100.


#### MaxPageRetrievals

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> MaxPageRetrievals { get; set; }
```

Maximum FetchXML pages fetched (0 = unlimited). Default: 200.


#### MaxParallelism

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> MaxParallelism { get; set; }
```

Worker threads for DML (0 = auto). Default: 0.


#### MaxResultRows

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> MaxResultRows { get; set; }
```

Maximum rows returned (0 = unlimited). Default: 0.


#### QueryTimeoutSeconds

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> QueryTimeoutSeconds { get; set; }
```

Cancel query after N seconds (0 = no timeout). Default: 300.


#### WarnDeleteThreshold

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> WarnDeleteThreshold { get; set; }
```

Prompt when deleting more than N records (0 = always prompt). Default: 0.


#### WarnInsertThreshold

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> WarnInsertThreshold { get; set; }
```

Prompt when inserting more than N records (0 = always prompt). Default: 1.


#### WarnUpdateThreshold

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> WarnUpdateThreshold { get; set; }
```
